PC-STRUCTURAL-DISCRIMINATION.description: HTTP fingerprint full-vector discrimination on stochastic Flask+SQLite mock server with 4 auth states (no_auth, valid_token, expired_token, invalid_token).
PC-STRUCTURAL-DISCRIMINATION.expected_behavior: Full-vector discrimination > 0.5 on auth-state changes (replicating parent 0.8333)

NC-NOISE-FP.description: Behavioral false positive rate on production-like noise-only samples (4 production-like noise types x 60 samples = 240 noise-only samples, no drift active).

B-SIMPLISTIC-NOISE-N480.description: Parent n=480 result with 4 simplistic noise types: TP=1.0 on all 4 token_refresh+noise conditions, behavioral_std 0.133-0.141, FP=0.0, TOST PASS at delta=0.15 (r=-0.037, CI upper 0.053).

B-ORTHOGONALITY-N480-MOCK.description: Four prior n=480 mock orthogonality experiments all confirm delta=0.15: EXP-GRAPH-35353011131 (r=0.046, CI upper 0.135), EXP-GRAPH-35389145821 (r=0.0022, CI upper 0.0916), EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 (r=-0.0258, CI upper 0.064), EXP-PRODUCT-35476271728 (r=-0.037, CI upper 0.053).
B-ORTHOGONALITY-N480-MOCK.expected_behavior: Production-like noise does not introduce behavioral-structural coupling that breaks orthogonality at delta=0.15
B-ORTHOGONALITY-N480-MOCK.observed_behavior: Pearson r=0.0161, CI upper 0.1055, TOST pass at delta=0.15, orthogonality confirmed.

observations: Phase A: 40 HTTP probes across 4 auth states. Full-vector discrimination 0.8333 (3 unique fingerprints for 4 states, expired_token and invalid_token collide on 401 authentication_failed). Baseline status-only discrimination 0.5, baseline body-only discrimination 0.8333.

Phase B: 480 paired samples collected across 4 co-occurring conditions (token_refresh x 4 production-like structural noises, 120 samples each). Each sample reads behavioral signal from /api/session/status and structural signal from /api/schema over real HTTP. All TP=1.0 on all 4 conditions.

Phase C: 240 noise-only samples (4 noises x 60) with NO drift active. All behavioral scores observed at exactly 0.05 (admin-role baseline), i.e., 0 samples at/above any tested detection threshold (0.25). FP=0.0.

Phase D: 60 isolated token_refresh samples with stochastic drift (p_refresh_success=0.7). Observed behavioral_mean=0.565, behavioral_std=0.1363. Score ranges from ~0.48 (refresh failure, 401 status) to ~0.65 (refresh success, 200 status). Both score values exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0.
Stochastic token_refresh behavioral variance confirmed: isolated std=0.1363 (vs parent std=0.1499). Under co-occurring noise, std ranges 0.1345-0.1465. All 4 conditions exceed the 0.05 variance gate.

TOST orthogonality at n=480: Pearson r=0.0161 (p=0.725, not significant), Fisher-z 95% CI [-0.0735, 0.1055]. TOST at delta=0.15: p_upper=0.0016 < 0.05 (PASS), p_lower=0.00013 < 0.05 (PASS). BOTH tails pass at n=480. CI upper bound 0.1055 is below 0.15 delta.

Production-like noise types increase structural variance compared to parent simplistic types: pagination_metadata structural_std=0.898, variable_length_data structural_std=0.4017, error_format_variation structural_std=0.4017, cdn_cache_headers structural_std=0.4078. Parent simplistic types had structural_std ~0.4.

Total real HTTP request cycles during measurement: ~780 (40 phase-A probes + 480 paired phase-B samples + 240 phase-C noise-only samples + 60 phase-D TP samples). No LLM calls; no network beyond localhost.
Runtime ~96s, single-threaded Werkzeug server (threaded=False) on 127.0.0.1:18951, seed=42 for the global Python RNG drawn before server start.
Frozen decision-rule outcome 'SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST' maps to canonical packet outcome SURVIVES (all of C1-C5 pass at the frozen ceiling).
validity_notes: Measurements are bounded to the localhost Flask 3.1.3 + SQLite mock server (prereg measurement_validity #7); they are not production-API measurements.

Stochastic token_refresh introduces bimodal behavioral scores: ~0.65 (refresh success, 70% of samples) and ~0.48 (refresh failure, 30% of samples). Both modes exceed the 0.25 detection threshold, so TP=1.0 despite the bimodality. The behavioral_std (0.1345-0.1465) is driven by this bimodal distribution, not by continuous severity variation.
C1 discrimination is 0.8333, not 1.0, because expired_token and invalid_token deliberately share one 401 authentication_failed surface (replicating parent baselines).

Production-like noise types add realistic structural complexity: pagination_metadata varies body key count by 2-6, variable_length_data varies data_list length 0-8 items, error_format_variation changes error body format by status code, cdn_cache_headers adds 3-4 CDN-specific headers. These increase structural variance beyond parent simplistic types.

Orthogonality confirmed under production-like structural noise: behavioral-structural Pearson r=0.0161 (p=0.725), CI upper bound 0.1055 < 0.15 delta. The behavioral signal remains independent of response structure complexity.

Threshold sensitivity analysis is EXPLORATORY and not part of frozen decision rule. The bimodal distribution (modes ~0.48 and ~0.65) creates a sharp TP cliff between thresholds 0.35 and 0.40. At threshold 0.40, only 69.4% of samples are detected (the failure-mode samples at ~0.48 fall below). This confirms the threshold tautology identified in the parent audit V3: thresholds 0.15-0.35 all achieve TP=1.0 because both modes exceed them.
The structural signal is a cardinality observable (body key count + semantic header count + status code). X-Request-Id/Date/Server/Content-Length/Connection excluded from fingerprints.
Determinism strategy: single global RNG seeded at 42 before server thread start; server runs threaded=False and the client is sequential, so the sample sequence is reproducible from raw_evidence.
This experiment does NOT make real LLM calls (prereg measurement_validity #8).
unresolved: Whether the parallel-channel freshness guard orthogonality survives on a non-mock production-like substrate with real OAuth/OIDC middleware, CDN caching, network RTT, and database-backed sessions (primary bottleneck for PRODUCT_CORE, inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether the expired_token/invalid_token fingerprint collision (identical 401 authentication_failed) generalizes to production endpoints with differentiated error details (inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether within-condition behavioral variance and structural variance maintain on real network RTT and cache-freshness distributions beyond localhost jitter/TTL (inherited from parent unknown category).

Whether token_refresh behavioral_score generalizes to production token refresh endpoints where refresh failure may produce different error surfaces or graded severity (inherited from parent unknown category).
Whether 4 production-like structural noise types are sufficient coverage for production schema drift (inherited from parent unknown category).

The threshold sensitivity analysis is EXPLORATORY and does not affect the primary SURVIVES/FALSIFIED decision. However, the sharp TP cliff between 0.35 and 0.40 (and the flat TP=1.0 across 0.15-0.35) suggests the bimodal distribution limits threshold calibration utility. Future work should consider continuous severity variation for production threshold calibration.

Production-like noise types increase structural variance but the behavioral signal remains at the same bimodal discrete levels (~0.48 and ~0.65). The behavioral score does not vary continuously with structural complexity.
